metadata.description: Marketplace for dashboard-builder, a Claude Code skill that turns marketing and business performance exports (CSV, XLSX, JSON, PDF) into KPI analysis, cross-source reconciliation, and executive dashboards or decks, with a comparability engine and a deterministic computation layer underneath.

plugins.name: dashboard-builder
plugins.description: Marketing & growth dashboard builder. Turns fragmented data from Adjust, AppsFlyer, GA4, Firebase, Play Console, Search Console, Braze, Insider, D·engage, Klaviyo, Iterable, Google/Meta/TikTok/LinkedIn Ads, CRM, e-commerce, subscription, cohort and finance sheets into KPI analysis, cross-channel comparability checks, cross-platform reconciliation, and executive dashboard or presentation output.
